# Presentation Contrast

Generated from committed public Scene evidence by `tools/presentation_contrast.py`.

Contrast constraints are an opt-in design option (Specification 46 section 8). For a Theme listed in `conformance/contrast-opt-in.yaml`, ordinary shape visibility or text legibility below its floor is an error and fails the check; a decoration below its floor (or on a ground that cannot be read) is a warning. For any other Theme every miss is a warning: it is listed and counted, and fails nothing. Independent encoded-fill misses are reported as warnings; authored Theme enforcement is checked by the render before Scene output.

A grouped encoded-fill warning may contribute to multiple purpose/role summary rows; row warning counts are not additive.
